design_principles.warmth: Every scene feels like a gentle hug
design_principles.safety: No sharp edges, no scary shadows, no overwhelming detail
design_principles.child_scale: Everything is sized for preschool viewers

environments.name: Zayd & Amira's Home
environments.description: A very cozy, warm house with rounded furniture, soft cream walls, mint-green window frames, and lavender curtains. There is a small round table with three chairs. A soft rug with warm patterns covers the floor. A bookshelf holds colorful books. The lighting is golden and gentle, like late afternoon sun.
environments.story_use: Family scenes, learning scenes, quiet emotional scenes

environments.name: Small Beautiful Mosque
environments.description: A beautiful, welcoming mosque with soft cream walls, a gentle green dome, and a small garden with flowers. The entrance has a rounded arch. Inside there is a soft carpet with gentle patterns, small low windows with colorful light, and a very calm feeling. It is sized so children feel welcome, not small.
environments.story_use: Learning duas, visiting with parents, feeling close to Allah

environments.name: Zayd & Amira's School
environments.description: A bright, colorful school with rounded doors, large windows, and a small playground. The walls are cream with soft green and peach decorations. There is a small library corner with pillows. A gentle teacher stands near a board with colorful drawings.
environments.story_use: Learning new things, making friends, playing gently

environments.name: Warm Park
environments.description: A beautiful park with soft green grass, round trees with gentle leaves, flowers in warm colors, a small pond with gentle ripples, and a playground with rounded equipment. The sky is light blue with soft clouds. Everything moves gently.
environments.story_use: Nature appreciation, playing with friends, family time

environments.name: Friendly Market
environments.description: A warm, colorful market with small stalls with rounded awnings. There are colorful fruits, soft fabric, beautiful small items, and very friendly vendors who smile. The ground is clean and warm. Everything is at child-scale.
environments.story_use: Learning about sharing, community, kindness to strangers

future_expansion_notes: New environments will follow the same warmth, safety, child-scale, and color rules. No dark or scary locations.
